scope: Local reconciliation of the verification carry for PM-1 rows F04-02, F04-03, F04-04, F04-05, F08-01 and F08-02 (targets: staging), one Library defect fix, and new test-only assertions for untested clauses. Evidence for a later successor scorecard; no PM-1 credit, gate or runtime state changes, and no staging readback was performed.
method: Independent architecture auditors mapped accepted clauses to current code and diffs; independent testers ran the planned existing tests (PostgreSQL files on a CI-like local PostgreSQL 16.15 cluster) and rechecked decisive claims. Coders wrote test-only files; independent testers then applied single-edit product mutations one at a time with byte-verified restore.
